title: One Service Account per Customer — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Rule.** Under Service Accounts and Repair Orders a customer holds at most 1 service account, and that one account is used at every store of the group. A change of tier updates the existing account; it never opens a second one. A customer who already has a service account that is not closed cannot open another.

**What the records must show.** Whether a customer already holds an account is read from the system's service account records for that customer — the account holder and the account's status — not from what the customer says. An account whose status is active or on credit hold counts as held; a closed account does not.

| Customer's existing account | May a new account be opened? |
|---|---|
| None on record | Yes |
| Active | No — the existing account is used |
| On credit hold | No — the existing account is used |
| Closed | Yes |

**Hypothetical.** A customer whose earlier account was closed and who returns for service may have a new account opened; a customer whose account is active at one store is served on that same account at another store of the group.
